mentions.name: ZigBee power meter
mentions.description: A homemade ZigBee power meter that keeps track of an electricity meter's LED pulses to monitor energy usage, implemented as an embedded project (built with CMake).
mentions.source_excerpt: Then I decided to hack my own ZigBee power meter (to keep track of my meter’s LED pulses) and fought with CMake for eight hours straight, because embedded.
